confidence_explanation: The timeline shows a clear progression from a brute-force attempt to a successful login from an unusual IP, followed by unauthorized privilege escalation, bulk cross-departmental data exfiltration, and an attempt to cover tracks by deleting authentication logs.

attack_chain.description: Brute-force attempt: multiple failed login attempts from an unusual IP (194.180.48.99) outside normal working hours.
Successful login from the same unusual IP after multiple failures.
Unauthorized privilege escalation to admin role.
Unauthorized access and download of sensitive files from the finance department, which is outside the user's normal directory scope.
Bulk exfiltration of files from multiple departments including HR, DevOps, and Marketing.
Anti-forensic activity: deletion of the authentication log (/var/log/auth.log) to hide traces of the intrusion.

gaps: Verification of whether the IP 194.180.48.99 is a known VPN or proxy used by the user.
Confirmation of whether the privilege escalation was triggered by a system vulnerability or a legitimate administrative command.
narrative: An attacker successfully compromised user_02's account following a brute-force attack from an unusual IP address. Once logged in, the attacker escalated privileges to admin, performed a bulk download of sensitive files across finance, HR, devops, and marketing departments, and finally attempted to delete authentication logs to evade detection.
